leakage_taxonomy: Kapoor and Narayanan (2023), Patterns 4(9):100804: L1.1 no test set; L1.2 pre-processing on train and test; L1.3 feature selection on train and test; L1.4 duplicates; L2 illegitimate features; L3.1 temporal leakage; L3.2 non-independence between train and test; L3.3 sampling bias in the test distribution

selector.rule: most DEV correct, then lowest DEV NLL, then earliest epoch; never TEST, never best seed

sealing: All models of a cohort are digested (completion_kit.commitments digest) and the digest commitment is published before any new TEST is revealed; procedure and external timing are task G17.1
exposure_rule: Every TEST access is logged here with its purpose; a revealed TEST is never used for selection or tuning (Dwork et al. 2015)
